correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md contains full dimensional reduction: M(s)=[[1-s^2/2,s],[-s(1-s^2/4),1-s^2/2]] with determinant 1. Independent symbolic SymPy multiplication verified trace(F)-2=(x+y)^2(xy-4)/4 and trace(F)+2=(x(x+y)-4)(y(x+y)-4)/4 for F=M(y)M(x). For a real determinant-one 2x2 matrix, |trace|<2 is power bounded; |trace|>2 yields hyperbolicity. At trace=2 xy=4, F12=-(x+y) nonzero, hence defective. At trace=-2, F=-I only if y=x and x^2=2 by upper-right/diagonal entries, otherwise defective. Therefore sole parabolic stable point is x=y=sqrt(2). Computed exact witness traces: (6/5,8/5) gives -1298/625 despite both steps stable, and (3,6/5) gives 59/250 despite first step hyperbolic. All positive x,y domain only; no implication to nonlinear/adaptive problems.
